c74object.name: touch.pfunction
c74object.digest: Multi-breakpoint curve and envelope generator with oscilloscope reticle
c74object.description: Modernized touch-first breakpoint function generator for Cycling '74 Max 9 (v8ui / jsui). Features true exponential ease curves, linear segments, anchor latching, precision oscilloscope framing with an uncluttered L-frame graticule, a standardized 280 px dual-mode 50/50 Attrui inspector, modern HSV color picker, bound ticker, and wireless synchronization with touch.master via the shared spectrum theme bus.

inlet.description: Accepts bang (outputs envelope stream), coordinate insertion messages (point, setcurve), envelope lists (list), utility triggers (clear, dump, popup), and any configuration attribute message.

outlet.description: Outputs delta-time formatted lists directly routable to line~ ([target_val delta_ms ...]) or curve~ ([target_val delta_ms curve_factor ...]).
Emits a bang whenever a node handle is moved, created, deleted, or segment curvature is adjusted.
Outputs absolute coordinate points: pairs [x, y] in line mode, or triplets [x, y, curve] in curve mode.

method.name: bang
method.description: Calculates and transmits the line~ or curve~ delta-time list through Outlet 0, followed by the raw points through Outlet 2.

method.name: point
method.digest: Set or insert a coordinate point
method.description: Sets coordinates for an existing point index or appends a new point. Curve values are clamped between -0.99 and +0.99.

method.name: setcurve
method.description: Adjusts the exponential ease curvature of the segment preceding the specified point index.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears all intermediate nodes, resetting the envelope to initial two-point boundary anchors.

method.name: list
method.description: Populates the envelope with a flat list of coordinates ([x0, y0, c0, x1, y1, c1...] in curve mode, or [x0, y0, x1, y1...] in line mode).

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens or closes the floating Attrui inspector window without arguments, or sets visibility explicitly with 1 or 0.

attribute.name: curve_mode
attribute.description: Toggles between exponential ease curvature (curve~, state 1) and straight linear segments (line~, state 0).

attribute.name: latch_first_point
attribute.digest: Lock first node to X min
attribute.description: When set to 1, the first breakpoint remains fixed at x_min. When set to 0, point 0 floats freely in time.

attribute.name: latch_last_point
attribute.digest: Lock last node to X max
attribute.description: When set to 1, the final breakpoint remains fixed at x_max. When set to 0, the final point floats freely in time.

attribute.name: raw_output_mode
attribute.description: 0 = On Bang / Release (outputs on mouse release or explicit bang); 1 = Continuous (streams coordinate updates live on every drag pixel).

attribute.name: x_min
attribute.description: Left boundary anchor of the envelope domain in milliseconds or samples.

attribute.name: x_max
attribute.description: Right boundary anchor of the envelope domain in milliseconds or samples.

attribute.name: y_min
attribute.description: Bottom amplitude boundary anchor of the envelope range.

attribute.name: y_max
attribute.description: Top amplitude boundary anchor of the envelope range.

attribute.name: display_value
attribute.description: 1 = Always show node coordinate labels; 0 = Peek on drag only (keeps canvas uncluttered when resting).

attribute.name: label_mode
attribute.description: 0 = Full string; 1 = No Vowels; 2 = Caps Only; 3 = First Letter; 4 = No Text (suppresses prefix tag completely).

attribute.name: case_mode
attribute.description: 0 = First Cap (Title Case); 1 = All Cap (Uppercase); 2 = All Small (Lowercase).

attribute.name: font_style
attribute.description: 0 = Regular; 1 = Bold; 2 = Italic; 3 = Bold Italic.

attribute.name: font_name
attribute.description: Typography typeface applied to coordinate readouts and prefix labels.

attribute.name: text_size
attribute.description: Point size for coordinate numbers on the main canvas (6 to 42 pt).

attribute.name: axis_style
attribute.description: 0 = Off; 1 = X Base (baseline only); 2 = L-Frame (X baseline + left Y rail); 3 = L-Frame + Ticks (adds 3.5 px notches at 0.0, 0.5, and 1.0 without numbers).

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Curvature radius of the 4 independent oscilloscope corner brackets.

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke width of the reticle chassis corner brackets in pixels.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of the straight reticle ticks extending from each corner arc along the chassis edges.

attribute.name: line_size
attribute.description: Stroke width of the envelope curve wire connecting breakpoints.

attribute.name: handle_size
attribute.description: Diameter in pixels of the interactive circular breakpoint handles.

attribute.name: track_margin
attribute.description: Padding inset in pixels from the chassis border preventing node handles from colliding with corner brackets.

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Displays the red launcher dot in the upper-right corner and enables right-click / ctrl-click popup launch.

attribute.name: show_settings_attrs
attribute.description: 1 = Full mode (displays 50/50 attribute rows, snaps to 280 px width); 0 = Mini mode (collapses rows, unlocks free XY elastic resizing).

attribute.name: mask_performance
attribute.description: Collapsible mask for Tier 1: operational modes, latching, bounds, and output streams.

attribute.name: mask_labels
attribute.description: Collapsible mask for Tier 2: value display rules, abbreviation algorithms, casing, and fonts.

attribute.name: mask_geometry
attribute.description: Collapsible mask for Tier 3: graticules, reticle dimensions, handle scale, margins, and line weights.

attribute.name: mask_colors
attribute.description: Collapsible mask for Tier 4: main component palette (chassis, brackets, wire, nodes, text).

attribute.name: mask_popup_colors
attribute.description: Collapsible mask for Tier 5: the complete 5-color inspector UI theme suite.

attribute.name: bg_color
attribute.description: Background fill color of the main canvas and inspector preview chassis.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: Color of the 4 oscilloscope corner arc brackets and graticule axes.

attribute.name: range_color
attribute.description: Color of the vector wire connecting envelope breakpoints.

attribute.name: handle_color
attribute.description: Color of circular breakpoint handles and curving arrowheads.

attribute.name: text_color
attribute.description: Color of active numerical coordinate readouts.

attribute.name: mode_color
attribute.description: Decoupled dedicated color applied to descriptive prefix labels and curving indicator frames.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: Color of the upper-right corner inspector launcher dot.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: Base background fill color for the floating inspector window.

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: Background fill for individual 50/50 attribute rows.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: Outline and slider trough stroke color inside inspector rows.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: Fill color for attribute drag gauges and number ticker columns.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: Font color for parameter names and numerical values inside the inspector.
